params.name: name
params.description: This is a parameter used to string search for a name or partial name of a budget. This parameter expects a string with the wildcard %.

params.name: steps
params.description: This parameter is used to only get specific steps. This parameter accepts a comma delimited list of step IDs.

params.name: budgets
params.description: This parameter is used to only get steps that are linked to a budget. This parameter accepts a comma delimited list of budget IDs.

params.name: locations
params.description: This parameter is used to only get steps that are linked to a budget at a specific location. This parameter accepts a comma delimited list of location IDs.

params.name: cursor
params.description: This parameter is a cursor that selects what stepID you want to start receiving results at. e.g. passing 137 here will only get you steps with an ID greater than 137.

params.name: limit
params.description: This parameter is a result limiter. The default is set to return no more than 100 results at one time.

This request returns your Budgets in Limble. 

Return data description

Property: budgetID, Description: The Budget's unique identifier.
Property: name, Description: The full name of the Budget.
Property: locationID, Description: Which Location this Budget belongs to.

This request updates an existing Budget.

Parameter: name, Type: String, Required?: Optional, Description: The title of this budget.
Parameter: awaitingAllowPOEdit, Type: Boolean, Required?: Optional, Description: When POs belonging to this budget are in the "ready to receive" state, will they be editable?
Parameter: awaitingEmailSend, Type: Boolean, Required?: Optional, Description: When POs belonging to this budget enter the "ready to receive" state, should the assignee(s) be emailed?
